items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: For instance, in the thing that Valerie Wilmer (phonetic) did, In The Face of The Black Music, it comes off that you think feeling in music is very important.

ctx.x: -- think feeling -- you talk about feelings being very important. For instance, in the thing that Valerie Wilmer (phonetic) did, In The Face of The Black Music, it comes off that you think feeling in music is very important. With the electronics taking over, how do you think feeling can be preserved or will it be preserved at all?

I don't see how it can be preserved with electronics. Electronics is cold. There's no feeling there. It's coming over a wire. You can't control it unless you got the button, whether you turn it up and down, loud and soft. But I mean, just that body feeling is hard.
